findings.note: In this Nov 26 CBS article, SportsLine's model picks Over 36.5, projects 40 combined points and has the Over hitting in 57% of simulations. It notes the Over has hit in each of Denver's last four games. Pittsburgh is starting Mason Rudolph after releasing Aaron Rodgers.

Covers' Nov 26 page forecasts about 17 mph southwest winds with gusts near 28 mph, around 42F, and a 65% chance of rain at kickoff. It lists Pittsburgh LBs Highsmith (ankle) and Herbig (hip/ribs) as iffy, and Neil Parker picks Broncos -4.5 rather than a total.

Neil Parker's early Covers pick from Nov 23 was Under 38.5, citing Pittsburgh's one-dimensional offense and the Steelers allowing 18 points per home game. The line has since dropped, from a 40.5 open to 36.5 at other books, so Bovada's 37 now gives only half a point more than the market.
